cells.gaps: The 14 service centres registering in the National Population Register in 2022 (SWZ-012) come with no total of offices, so the count is a floor; the software 'installed in all centres' is equipped, not registering, and the AfDB and COMESA 'all offices' (SWZ-016) carries no count. The only total held is in a governance row of December 2024 (SWZ-015: 15 service centres including headquarters, and 5 hospital points), a different year and not read against the count. The World Bank's June 2026 appraisal disagrees with the older facts: well over 90% of civil records on paper (SWZ-001) and electronic civil registry services not active (SWZ-004). No rural share and no office figure within two years.
cells.note: Stage 3 because births and deaths are keyed into the National Population Register at the service centres on registration (SWZ-010, SWZ-017). Not stage 4: the office figure is a count with no denominator.
